exact_zero.problem: The first-party training DMTet unnecessarily aborted on an exact zero lattice sample. The sign-case needs a deterministic symbolic tie-break; an exact zero is not a scientific failure.
exact_zero.repair: Evaluate mesh field in FP32. For any remaining exact zero, add a deterministic infinitesimal checkerboard sign perturbation only to the training extractor surrogate before sign classification/interpolation; record the count. Abort only on nonfinite values or pathological zero multiplicity.

gradient_scale.problem: The old [0.25,4.0] clamp was dimensionally inappropriate for an absolute VJP scale and would have overwhelmed the base C objective.
gradient_scale.repair: Use the measured raw equal-norm scale directly. Require finite positive scale in [1e-8,1.0] and verify reconstructed scaled mesh/base norm ratio in [0.95,1.05]. Freeze that exact scale after step 0.

proxy_semantics.observation: The initial soft-alpha fg_miss values were ~0.586..0.641 despite the frozen-C product decoder having ~0.998 minimum Stage13 recall. Soft alpha is not a hard coverage metric, so this does not yet prove proxy failure, but a parity check is mandatory before training.
proxy_semantics.repair: At step 0, hard-rasterize the same training DMTet mesh with both PyTorch3D signed-distance coverage and the exact Stage13 half-integer top-left rasterizer. Require min per-view IoU >=0.99 between those two hard masks. Also compare the 256-grid training mesh hard mask to the frozen-C product Stage13 predicted masks and require min recall and precision >=0.95. Abort as apparatus mismatch otherwise.

rasterizer_decision.reason: Current NVlabs/nvdiffrast LICENSE.txt is NVIDIA Source Code License (1-Way Commercial) with Section 3.3 limiting non-NVIDIA use to non-commercial research/evaluation and excluding direct or indirect monetary gain. Historical RealSaS nvdiffrast use remains valid research lineage; the investor-demo selection lane avoids introducing it as a new dependency.

preserved_scientific_intervention: EXTRACTED_CANONICAL_MESH -> DIFFERENTIABLE_SOURCE_VIEW_RASTER LOSS -> IRIS VJP, with frozen C/F*/DINO/TP64/source cameras and unchanged final product decoder+Stage13.
